files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Support for Nextcloud 32, 33, 34 and 35.

### Removed

- Nextcloud 27. Its legacy Files list never showed the actions from this app, so
  the declared support was not real. The declared range is now `>=28 <=35`, and
  instances on 27 stay on 0.3.1.

### Fixed

- **"Assinar com SignDocs Brasil" and "Status da assinatura" appear in the Files
  menu on Nextcloud 33 and later.** Those versions changed how the Files app
  reads its actions, so an action registered the old way was ignored without
  any error. One build now registers on both.

### Changed (dependencies)

- `signdocs-brasil/signdocs-brasil-php` 1.11.0 → 2.2.0. The only breaking change
  removes three webhook event cases this app never used.
